remarks:
Timeless Elegance & Modern Luxury on Historic Mayfair Lane! An extraordinary opportunity to own a residence of distinction on Buffalo’s coveted Mayfair Lane. Designed by renowned architect E.B. Greene, this enchanting private lane is celebrated for its architectural character, tranquility, and proximity to the best of the city. With a recent $2 million lane renovation, Mayfair Lane offers a rare combination of historic beauty, privacy, and modern peace of mind—just moments from Elmwood Village, Allentown, downtown, and the Medical Campus. Beyond the newly remodeled lane, this exceptional townhouse welcomes you with a gracious foyer and generous coat storage. The beautifully appointed living room showcases pristine oak hardwood floors, a gas fireplace, custom built-ins, classic shutters, fresh paint, and a striking light fixture. An elegant formal dining room provides an ideal setting for entertaining. The fully remodeled kitchen blends timeless style with contemporary luxury. Beautiful marble countertops and backsplash, a ceramic sink, abundant cabinetry, and stainless-steel appliances create a space that is as refined as it is functional. The second-floor primary suite features three closets, a luxurious en-suite bath, and an inviting bay window. Two additional bedrooms offer exceptional flexibility, including one with its own en-suite bath.
The third floor offers a spacious bonus room—additional to recorded square footage—plus substantial unfinished storage. The partially finished lower level adds a versatile bedroom or bonus room, full bath, and laundry/utility area. Modern comforts include central air, attached one-car garage parking, and an additional covered parking space. With its architectural pedigree, sophisticated renovations, abundant living space, and unparalleled location, this remarkable Mayfair Lane residence offers a lifestyle rarely found in Buffalo: historic character, contemporary luxury, and complete privacy within effortless reach of the city’s finest destinations.
